title: Mids frame
description: Mid prices of one venue dex, from Hyperliquid's `allMids` stream (the liveness canary of decision 0006 §2.2). The venue stamps no time on it: its age is our receipt time. Mirrors src/domain/marketdata/frames.ts (MidsFrame).

dex.description: "" is the main dex; otherwise the HIP-3 dex name.

mids.description: Coin name as the venue writes it (`BTC`, `xyz:SPCX`, `@107` for a spot pair) → mid price.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.
